question: List every open bug in 2.3.1 and its workaround.
expected_answer: BUG-2310-01 (Critical): auto-match does not convert foreign-currency amounts; use manual matching for those transactions. BUG-2310-02 (High): invoices over 25 line items export as a single-page PDF; send the email link or keep to 25 lines. BUG-2310-03 (Low): date picker starts weeks on Sunday; cosmetic, type dates directly.
evidence: | BUG-2310-01 | Critical | Open | Auto-match in bank reconciliation does not convert foreign-currency transactions before comparing amounts, so multi-currency accounts see most transactions left unmatched. |
On 2.3.1, foreign-currency amounts are not converted before they are compared (BUG-2310-01). Use manual matching for those transactions.
> Known issue: BUG-2310-02 (High, Open): Invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single-page PDF, silently dropping remaining line items. Affects 2.3.1.
This is cosmetic. Report data is correct. Type dates directly into the range fields if the calendar is confusing.

question: What are all the ways a client's payment can be recorded against an invoice?
expected_answer: Clients can pay in the portal by card or bank transfer (ACH or SEPA), recorded automatically; payments received outside the portal, such as bank transfers or checks, are recorded with Record Payment.
evidence: Clients can pay by card or bank transfer (ACH in the US, SEPA in the EU).
Record payments you receive outside the client portal, such as bank transfers or checks.

question: Summarize how bank feeds and reconciliation changed from 2.0.0 to 2.3.1.
expected_answer: On 2.0.0 to 2.2.x feeds synced once a day and reconciliation was manual. 2.3.0 added auto-match and sync every 4 hours. On 2.3.1, auto-match does not convert foreign currency (BUG-2310-01), so foreign-currency transactions need manual matching.
evidence: Since 2.3.0, connected bank feeds sync every 4 hours. Before 2.3.0 they synced once a day.
Manual reconciliation has been available since 2.0.0 and is still the fallback when auto-match cannot find a match.
On 2.3.1, foreign-currency amounts are not converted before they are compared (BUG-2310-01). Use manual matching for those transactions.

question: What reporting features differ by plan?
expected_answer: Saved custom reports: 10 on Starter, 100 on Professional, unlimited on Enterprise. Scheduled report emails: Professional and Enterprise only.
evidence: | Saved custom reports | 10 | 100 | Unlimited |
> Note: Scheduled report emails are available on Professional and Enterprise.

question: List every limit that applies to API v2 traffic.
expected_answer: Per-minute rate limits of 60, 300, or 1,000 by plan; at most 10 requests in flight per key; list pages of up to 100 items; Idempotency-Key results are kept for 24 hours.
evidence: | Enterprise | 1,000 |
Besides the per-minute rate limit, each API key can have at most 10 requests in flight at once.
| Pagination | ?page=2&per_page=50 | ?cursor=...&limit=100 |
Send an Idempotency-Key header on POST requests. Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

question: What security points can I share with a prospect?
expected_answer: TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest; two-step verification for every user; a SOC 2 Type II report on request; data hosted in the US and EU; an audit log on Enterprise (13 months). SSO (SAML) is not available.
evidence: - SOC 2 Type II report available on request
InvoicePilot encrypts data in transit with TLS 1.2 or later and at rest with AES-256.
InvoicePilot does not support SSO or SAML sign-in on any plan today.

question: Which bugs have affected the client portal, and are they fixed?
expected_answer: BUG-2200-01, the Safari login loop, fixed within 2.2.0; and BUG-2210-01, the hidden Pay now button for partially paid invoices on 2.2.1, fixed in 2.3.0.
evidence: BUG-2200-01: Safari users were redirected back to the login page after successful authentication due to a cookie SameSite misconfiguration.
This is BUG-2210-01 (High). It affected 2.2.1. It was fixed in 2.3.0.

question: What happens to an invoice's number and its payment reminders when it is voided?
expected_answer: A voided invoice stays in reports with a zero balance and a VOID watermark, and its number is never reused. Since 2.2.1, voiding in bulk also cancels its scheduled reminders (on 2.2.0 they had to be cancelled by hand).
evidence: Voided invoices stay in reports with a zero balance and show a VOID watermark.
Numbers are never reused, even if an invoice is voided.
- Since 2.2.1, a bulk void cancels reminders automatically.

question: What does the Python SDK do to make retries safe?
expected_answer: It retries IP-4290, IP-4291, IP-5000, and IP-5030 automatically with backoff up to max_retries (default 2), never retries 4xx validation errors, and accepts idempotency_key on creates; Idempotency-Key on POST calls makes retries safe.
evidence: The SDK retries IP-4290, IP-4291, IP-5000, and IP-5030 automatically with backoff, up to max_retries times (default 2). It never retries 4xx validation errors.
4. Add Idempotency-Key to POST calls so retries are safe.
